summary.en: Hyundai Motor's global venture capital and open-innovation network (CRADLE) with hubs in Korea, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), Tel Aviv, Berlin, Beijing and Singapore. Invests in and partners with global startups across mobility, UAM/smart city, autonomous AI & sensors, electrification, robotics, and connectivity to feed Hyundai's future-mobility roadmap.
summary.local: 현대자동차의 글로벌 벤처투자·오픈이노베이션 조직(CRADLE). 모빌리티, UAM·스마트시티, 자율주행 AI·센서, 에너지·전동화, 로보틱스, 커넥티비티 등에 투자하며 실리콘밸리·텔아비브·베를린·베이징·싱가포르에 거점.
